title: Tech Note: OCI Mapper 2004.3
author: Josh Fletcher, Technical Support Engineer, 4D, Inc.
featured_technology: OCI cursors, error handling (OD ON ERROR CALL, OD Last Error)

historical_commentary.text: This note documents an update to the OCI Mapper, a 4D component that emulated the discontinued 4D Oracle plug-in's high-level commands on top of the newer, lower-level 4D for OCI plug-in introduced in 4D 2004, aiming to give 4D Oracle developers an upgrade path without rewriting source code. It is squarely about a legacy Oracle connectivity transition (4D Oracle to 4D for OCI) that predates 4D's own native SQL engine (v11, 2007) by over a year, and the entire plug-in stack it discusses (4D Oracle, 4D for OCI, OCI Mapper) is long retired from current 4D products, making this note historical archive material for anyone maintaining decades-old 4D-Oracle systems rather than a practical current-day reference.
related_updates: 4D Oracle (the original high-level Oracle plug-in) had already been discontinued by the time of 4D 2004, prompting the OCI Mapper transition tool described here
4D's later native SQL engine (v11, 2007) and subsequent database connectivity features superseded this entire generation of Oracle plug-ins and community mapping components
